about: The rhythm engine (docs/RHYTHM_TO_FORM.md, the owner's specification, 4 November 2026; public/shared/euclidean.js): its rhythmic layers, an isochronous chain, each M events of the one below per event of its own, from the shortest a listener hears as rhythm up to the piece.

rhythm-layers.about: Where the layers stand in time: the beat's band, in which the layer X(0) lies, and the shortest period any layer has (euclidean.js RHYTHM, layerChain, divisions).

slowestBeat.reason: the owner, 4 November 2026: X(0) is 'an isochronous continuing series of events ... in the tempo range of about 60–180 BPM (1–3 Hz)'; 'The tempo is based approximately on human heart rates'

fastestBeat.reason: the owner's band's fastest, as slowestBeat

shortestPeriod.reason: the owner, 4 November 2026: 'Layer X(n) is the minimum layer if its period is less than 50ms (or its tempo is less than 20Hz). This minimum results from the phenomenal threshold at which tempo becomes pitch': read as the shortest period a layer may have, a layer under it being pitch, not rhythm
